subtitle: GPU tuning for {card} using amdgpu OverDrive
custom_appearance_detail: Configure the Custom theme wallpaper and overlay transparency.
wallpaper_opacity_detail: How visible the selected image is behind the interface.
panel_opacity_detail: How solid the interface panels are over the wallpaper.
unsafe_tuning_detail: {mhz} MHz at {mv} mV is below the safety floor for high clocks. Use at least 850 mV, and preferably 900 mV or more near 2000 MHz.
low_voltage_detail: {mhz} MHz at {mv} mV may be unstable on the BC-250. Artifacts, driver resets, crashes, or display loss are possible.
apply_profile_detail: This will start a background loop applying {mhz} MHz / {mv} mV every {interval} seconds.
reset_od_detail:
This stops the active loop, sends the amdgpu OverDrive reset command, and returns DPM control to auto when available.

On some BC-250 cards this may restore stock behavior. On others it may keep the last manual SCLK/VDDC point, especially after aggressive tuning.
